claims: Mike Braun is the current Governor of Indiana.
Mike Braun assumed office on January 13, 2025.
Mike Braun is the 52nd governor of Indiana.
Mike Braun is the successor to former Governor Eric Holcomb.
Mike Braun was sworn in on January 13, 2025.
Mike Braun previously served as a U.S. Senator for Indiana.
The Governor's office is located in Indianapolis.
In his 2026 State of the State address, Mike Braun emphasized reducing property taxes.
In his 2026 State of the State address, Mike Braun emphasized cutting government spending.
In his 2026 State of the State address, Mike Braun emphasized reducing Medicaid costs.
In his 2026 State of the State address, Mike Braun emphasized reviewing state cannabis laws.
Recent initiatives focus on 10% operational budget cuts for most agencies.
Qualifications to become Governor of Indiana require being a citizen of the United States.
Qualifications to become Governor of Indiana require being at least thirty (30) years of age.
Qualifications to become Governor of Indiana require having resided in Indiana for at least five (5) years immediately preceding the election.
As of March 2026, Governor Braun has been named 2025 Governor of the Year by the Foundation for Government Accountability.
